english.title: Establish / use / install a wireless telegraphy station / apparatus without a section 8 licence
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..)

(A)_[established a wireless telegraphy station,]_
(B)_[used a wireless telegraphy station,]_
(C)_[installed wireless telegraphy apparatus,]_
(D)_[used wireless telegraphy apparatus,]_

for the purpose of making a broadcast, otherwise than in accordance with a wireless telegraphy licence granted by OFCOM under section 8 of the Wireless Telegraphy Act 2006
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 8 and 35(1) and (2) of the Wireless Telegraphy Act 2006.

english.notes:
(i) Section 41 of the Wireless Telegraphy Act 2006 sets out the procedure for prosecutions where the offence consists in the contravention of the terms, provisions or limitations of a wireless telegraphy licence or of an exemption under section 8(3) of the Act.
(ii) Section 105 of the Act makes special provisions for this offence in relation to ships and aircraft.
(iii) Section 106 of the Act applies where a person is convicted of this offence and the use continues after the conviction.
(iv) Section 107 of the Act provides for proceedings and enforcement regarding this offence.
(v) Section 110 of the Act provides for criminal liability of company directors, managers, etc.

other.penalty:
Either way
Summary: maximum 6/12 months imprisonment and/or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: maximum 2 years imprisonment and/or a fine.

The maximum penalty on summary conviction is 6 months for offences committed before 2nd May 2022, see paragraph 16(a) of Schedule 8 to the Act; for offences committed on or after that date it may be 6 or 12 months depending on the general limit in a magistrates’ court, see section 35(2)(a) of the Act and section 224(1) and (1A) of the Sentencing Act 2022.
On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
